   (+0.32%), zscore +1.54 POS, trend_quality STRONG_UP, linreg_direction LEAN_BULL,
   15m/1h slopes positive. Negatives: velocity SLOW, volume_regime LOW, market_phase
   DECLINING (score 73.6) -> up structure, lazy tape.
2. Regime scanners (15m_regime.log last 24h): aggregate flips/24h = 20, BTC = 24 — normal
   band (p50 19-20, p95 26); NOT the >=26 unstable flag, NOT the rare <6 trend tape.
   Latest dump 20:30: aggregate overall = LONG_BIAS (24L/19S/78N of 121 tokens — note the
   5m aggregate flipped SHORT_BIAS -> LONG_BIAS since last cycle), regimes.BTC = NEUTRAL
   conf 67.4 (ranging, r2 0.03), watchdog btc_15m = LONG_BIAS, btc_4h = LONG_BIAS.
3. `auto_trader`: CHOP, 6+ consecutive BRACKET/MANAGE_ONLY, price 60,118-60,486.
4. Alt tape: strongest confirmed shorts are APT conf 93.4 (-1.09%), JUP 87.3, KLUNC 89.1,
   MON 91.8; strongest longs NEAR 90.7 (+1.45%), NXPC 88, SKY 85.1, SOPH 82.5.

Meaning for the book: every source that covers BTC says the 1m/15m/4h structure is up or
neutral — nothing says down. The single open LONG is aligned with the only tape that has
direction. Alts are mixed-to-bleeding but BTC-neutral + LOW volume = chop for entries; the
auto_trader CHOP verdict agrees. Re-test condition for the whole long book: a 1m close
holding below EMA300 (now 60,256) for 15-30m flips alignment — 0 such ticks in the last 60m.
Flip-rate context: 20/24 per 24h means snapshot directional prose is cheap-to-wrong; all
steers above are written as re-testable conditions.
